scope: Static JavaScript URL escape decoding in Grabber
change: Decode hexadecimal, four-digit Unicode and braced code-point escapes in recognized URL literals.
Support paired UTF-16 surrogates and escaped CR/LF line continuations.
Reject malformed escapes, unpaired surrogates, control characters and dynamic concatenation.
delivery: Source and isolated native test binaries; personal application and packaged installer unchanged.
limitations: Static discovery only; not full JavaScript execution or parsing.
No new direct IDM comparison was performed. Full parity remains unproven.
